claims.claim_text: Researchers Wenji Fang, Yao Lu, Jinghua Wang and Zhiyao Xie posted an arXiv paper on autonomous RTL and synthesis optimization using LLM agents.
claims.excerpt: Authors:Wenji Fang, Yao Lu, Jinghua Wang, Zhiyao Xie

claims.claim_text: The paper was submitted to arXiv on 10 November 2026.
The authors present Dr. RTL, a multi-agent framework that automates critical-path analysis, RTL rewriting and implementation-level evaluation.
claims.excerpt: We present Dr. RTL, a multi-agent framework that automates critical-path analysis, RTL rewriting, and implementation-level evaluation, while continuously improving through reusable optimization skills.

claims.claim_text: The authors say Dr. RTL continuously improves through reusable optimization skills.
claims.excerpt: while continuously improving through reusable optimization skills

claims.claim_text: The authors report that, on 20 real-world RTL designs, Dr. RTL achieves average WNS/TNS improvements of 21%/17% with a 6% area reduction over commercial synthesis.
claims.excerpt: Evaluated on 20 real-world RTL designs, Dr.~RTL achieves average WNS/TNS improvements of 21\%/17\% with a 6\% area reduction over commercial synthesis.

claims.claim_text: The paper discusses reference-based and open-ended RTL optimization benchmarks meant to evaluate optimization under realistic EDA workflows.
claims.excerpt: We discuss reference-based and open-ended RTL optimization benchmarks that evaluate optimization opportunities under realistic EDA workflows.

claims.claim_text: The paper also explores agent-driven synthesis script tuning and discovery of executable synthesis algorithms.
claims.excerpt: We explore agent-driven synthesis script tuning and the discovery of executable synthesis algorithms across intermediate representations, technology-independent optimization, and technology mapping.

claims.claim_text: The authors envision AI-native design automation jointly exploring architectural, RTL and EDA algorithm design spaces.
claims.excerpt: we envision AI-native design automation that jointly explores architectural, RTL, and EDA algorithm design spaces, guided by verification constraints and implementation feedback.

claims.claim_text: The paper is an invited paper for ASP-DAC 2027.
